argv:
set -euo pipefail
fixed_root="/vaso/build/torchaudio-cu130"
if [ "$(cat "$fixed_root/owner" 2>/dev/null)" != "{work}" ]; then
  echo "fixed torch build root $fixed_root is owned by another action" >&2
  exit 2
fi
set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; rm -rf "{work}/wheelhouse"; mkdir -p "{work}/wheelhouse"; python3 -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-index --no-cache-dir -w "{work}/wheelhouse" "/vaso/build/torchaudio-cu130/src"; set -- "{work}/wheelhouse"/torchaudio-*.whl; if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -f "$1" ]; then echo 'expected exactly one wheel matching torchaudio-*.whl' >&2; exit 2; fi

set -euo pipefail
fixed_root="/vaso/build/torchaudio-cu130"
rm -rf "$fixed_root"
mkdir -p "$fixed_root/src"
printf "%s\n" "{work}" > "$fixed_root/owner"
cp -a "{src}/." "$fixed_root/src/"
env_file="$1"
shift
root="$PWD"
abs_prefix() ( case "$1" in /*) printf "%s\n" "$1" ;; *) printf "%s/%s\n" "$root" "$1" ;; esac )
torch="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
python="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
python_venv="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_pip="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_setuptools="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_wheel="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_filelock="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
cuda="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
ninja="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
compiler_prefix_map_flags=""
cuda_prefix_map_flags=""
for logical_map_root in $torch $python $python_venv $py_pip $py_setuptools $py_wheel $py_filelock $cuda $ninja; do
  resolved_map_root="$(readlink -f "$logical_map_root" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$logical_map_root")"
  for map_root in "$logical_map_root" "$resolved_map_root"; do
    compiler_prefix_map_flags="$compiler_prefix_map_flags -ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
    cuda_prefix_map_flags="$cuda_prefix_map_flags -Xcompiler=-ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
  done
done
python3 - "/vaso/build/torchaudio-cu130/src/tools/setup_helpers/extension.py" <<'PY'
import pathlib
import sys
path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if 'shlex.split(os.environ.get("NVCC_FLAGS", ""))' not in text:
    if "import shlex" not in text:
        text = text.replace("import os\n", "import os\nimport shlex\n", 1)
    needle = '        extra_compile_args["nvcc"] = ["-O2", "-DUSE_CUDA"]\n'
    if needle not in text:
        raise SystemExit("torchaudio extension helper no longer has the expected nvcc flag stanza")
    text = text.replace(
        needle,
        needle
        + '        nvcc_flags = shlex.split(os.environ.get("NVCC_FLAGS", ""))\n'
        + '        extra_compile_args["nvcc"].extend(nvcc_flags)\n',
        1,
    )
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
PY
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$env_file")" "{work}/home" "{work}/pip-cache"
cat > "$env_file" <<EOF
set -euo pipefail
export BUILD_VERSION=2.11.0
export USE_CUDA=1
export USE_ROCM=0
export BUILD_RNNT=1
export BUILD_ALIGN=1
export BUILD_CUDA_CTC_DECODER=1
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0
export PYTHONHOME=
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
export PIP_NO_INDEX=1
export PIP_NO_INPUT=1
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CUDAFLAGS="$CUDAFLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export NVCC_FLAGS="$NVCC_FLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export CMAKE_C_COMPILER="$CC"
export CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$CXX"
export CUDA_HOME="$cuda"
export CUDA_PATH="$cuda"
export PYTHONPATH="$torch/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_pip/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_setuptools/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_wheel/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_filelock/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$python_venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
export PATH="$python_venv/bin:$python/bin:$py_pip/bin:$py_wheel/bin:$ninja/bin:$cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$torch/lib:$torch/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/lib:$cuda/lib64:$cuda/lib"
export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$torch:$python:$cuda:$ninja"
export MAX_JOBS={jobs}
export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL={jobs}
export HOME="{work}/home"
export PIP_CACHE_DIR="{work}/pip-cache"
EOF
